english: A hole in the wall. With your hand in it.
Alone in this dark hallway, you look upon the object in your hands.
A clawed hand. Bronze and jade.
The jade inlays catch the dim light.
Light goes in. Nothing comes out.
Your finger touches the ABSENCE of surface.
The tip of your finger is... gone.
It didn't cut. It didn't burn.
You are not going to lick it.
